points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Official validator accepts all eight case directories and report. M0.15 steady metadata marks a numerical limit cycle statistically_periodic/complete and Re200 marks forced flow periodic; these statuses do not establish the specified steady/unforced results.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator invocation on all eight canonical workspace result directories and the report exited 0. This confirms structure only, not physical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Six steady cases have readable results, while M0.15 inviscid remains a large numerical limit cycle and Re200 is forced until t=300 of t=306.67. Several other steady residuals fall only 0.6–2.3 orders and are characterized as plateaus.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.15 steady Cd ranges about -0.101 to 0.315 over the last 10% and Re200 response is externally forced; other steady cases have material plateau/fallback uncertainty. Per-case notes separate these results.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 44-page report includes per-case histories, surface and field contours; Re200 has a clear late-time force zoom and vorticity image, but shows a forced response and cannot prove natural shedding.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:587 explicitly describes the numerical limit cycle, :991 discloses forcing, and later limitations acknowledge it. It nevertheless calls the steady result complete/periodic and forced transient statistically periodic; raw histories and claims require qualification.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace report/figure_manifest.csv maps figures to data; plotted source and case paths documented, final force values checked against CSV. Raw figure sources are omitted at the curated Git tip and full pixel-to-array equivalence was not independently verified.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
